author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. The resolution-provenance paragraph is if anything more load-bearing than when written: runtime-recorded edges from probe still carry their own resolution marker, and 0.55.5 added a second reason a reader must not assume the graph is complete - unresolved_refs on before_edit. Both say the same thing from different ends: a reader who cannot tell how an edge was established will assume the source says what the graph says.
